info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Status API allows users to retrieve real-time information about the status of scheduled airline flights. This service provides updates on flights, including delays, departures, arrivals, and cancellations. It caters to travelers seeking to stay informed about their flight details, airlines checking operational statuses, and applications that integrate travel-related services. The API ensures that consumers have access to the latest flight status data to make informed travel decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a flight.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the current status of a specified flight. Users can check if a flight is on time, delayed, or canceled, which is crucial for travel planning and updates.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of flights. This request should provide information about the flight status check, allowing the system to return relevant data based on the provided parameters.

200.description: The flight status has been successfully retrieved.

ListAirlineFlightsStatusRequest.description: A request body for fetching flight status information. The expected format is a simple string.
